configurations.name: verify
runtimeArgs: bun run build && bunx wrangler dev -c dist/pi_durable_replay/wrangler.json --port 8799 --var CONTROL_TOKEN:local-verify-token --var SEARCH_BACKEND:corpus

configurations.name: verify-alt
runtimeArgs: bunx vite build --outDir dist-alt && bunx wrangler dev -c dist-alt/pi_durable_replay/wrangler.json --port 8801 --inspector-port 9339 --persist-to .wrangler-alt --var CONTROL_TOKEN:local-verify-token --var SEARCH_BACKEND:corpus
